name: Çayır Tavşanı
scene: A seated rabbit with long ears in a meadow.
notes: Elegant left-facing seated rabbit with upright ears, rounded haunch and tail; flowing meadow leaves and sky divisions. Target 76–116 panes; raster connected-component estimate 98 coloured regions, not a geometry audit. Reviewed both generations; selected second for opaque white exterior and clearer enclosed round eye. Rabbit uses amber/terracotta, background teal/blue. Remaining doubts: subtle shading persists, some same-colour neighbours may merge during tracing, and close junctions at ear roots, chest and lower foliage need geometry review. No obvious loose line ends. This is a design sheet only, not validated playable geometry or finished glass artwork.
